content.title: Mexico vs Portugal Lineups, Live Streams, Cable, How & Where to Watch In the USA
content.text: Tonight, Mexico will host Portugal at the Estadio Azteca, now known as the Estadio Banorte, which has been newly renovated. The stadium reopens tonight and will host two teams that will feature in the 2026 World Cup.Mexico is one of the host nations for the 2026 World Cup and will look to continue its winning form after three friendly matches over the last two months.AdvertisementMexico defeated Panama 1-0, defeated Bolivia 1-0, and defeated Iceland 4-0, but with a full team of players who play in Liga MX.Last November, Mexico played against Uruguay and Paraguay. The match against Uruguay was a 0-0 draw, and the match against Paraguay finished in a 1-2 loss in the United States.Raul Jimenez of Mexico kicks the ball during an international friendly between Mexico and Uruguay at Corona Stadium on November 15, 2025 in Torreon, Mexico. (Photo by Yair Gonzalez/Jam Media/Getty Images)Photo by Yair Gonzalez/Jam Media/Getty Images (Photo by Yair Gonzalez/Jam Media/Getty Images)Portugal will play their first friendly match following their UEFA World Cup qualifiers. Portugal topped their group that consisted of Ireland, Hungary, and Armenia.AdvertisementIn their last World Cup qualifier, Portugal defeated Armenia 9-1 at home without Cristiano Ronaldo, who was suspended due to a red card against Ireland.The goal scorers for Portugal's 9-1 win were Renato Veiga, Goncalo Ramos, Francisco Conceicao, and hat-tricks from Bruno Fernandes and Joao Neves.Official Lineups for Mexico and PortugalMexicoGoalkeeper: Raul 'Tala' RangelDefenders: Jesús Gallardo, César Montes, Johan Vásquez, Israel ReyesMidfielders: Erik Lira, Obed Vargas, Alvaro Fidalgo,Forwards: Brian Gutierrez, Raul Jimenez, Roberto AlvaradoPortugalGoalkeeper: Rui SilvaDefenders: Nuno Mendes, Renato Viega, António Silva, Matheus NunesMidfielders: Samu Costa, Ruben Neves, Bruno FernandesForwards: Joao Felix, Goncalo Ramos, Francisco ConceicaoThe Mexico vs Portugal match will kick off at 9 p.m. ET/ 6 p.m. PT in the United States. The match will kick off at 7 p.m. local time at the Estadio Banorte in Mexico City, Mexico.AdvertisementThe match will be available to watch in the United States, Mexico, and Portugal across select TV channels and streaming services.TUDN (USA)Univision (USA)FOX Deportes (USA)Canal 5 (Mexico)TUDN Mexico (Mexico)ViX (Mexico)RTP Play (Portugal)This story was originally published by Athlon Sports on Mar 28, 2026, where it first appeared in the Soccer section.
